## 分诊：`domain:cli` / `bug` + `finding` / **`needs-user-decision`** / `priority:p2` ⛔ `needs-user-decision` 不与 `pm:*` 并存（先例 #15854 / #15617 / #15542），故不挂 `pm:queue`。 ## 卡片明确要求「acted on 之前先复核」——本席已独立复核，逐条如下 | 卡片主张（转述自 dev 席，未经填卡席复核） | 本席在 `origin/main` 的实读 | 结论 | |---|---|---| | gate 是 `declaredHttpStatus(error) >= 500` 单条件 | `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts:571-572`：
`const declaredStatus = declaredHttpStatus(error);`
`if (declaredStatus === undefined \|\| declaredStatus < 500) return undefined;` | ✅ 逐字成立 | | 消息被换成 `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE` | `:576` `error: INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE,`，**无条件** | ✅ | | 它是 #11718 抬出来的单一中继 | `:1397` `// [#11718] The arm's BODY now lives in {@link declaredServerFaultAnswer}` / `:1403` `const declaredServerFault = declaredServerFaultAnswer(error);` | ✅ | | `[REST] Unhandled error` 带 stack | `:2416 logError('[REST] Unhandled error:', error);`，`:2409` 档注 `Log "[REST] Unhandled error" only when resolved is a genuine fault.` | ✅ | **四条全部成立，本席无更正。** 卡片自称的「未独立复核」这一条，现在已被复核。 --- ## ⭐ 但本席读到一件卡片没看到、且**实质改变问题形状**的事 卡片结尾把待答问题写成：*"what distinguishes a refusal from a fault, mechanically? — a producer-side declaration, a status/code pair on a published allow-list, or something else."* **那个判别器已经存在了，就在同一个函数体里，比 gate 晚五行。** `:577`： ```ts body: { error: INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE, ...(declaresServerFault({ status: declaredStatus, code: error?.code }) ? thrownCodeFields(error, declaredStatus) : {}), }, ``` 即 `declaredServerFaultAnswer` **已经在用 `declaresServerFault({status, code})` 这个"status/code 对"判别器**——但只用它决定**要不要带 `code` 字段**，没用它决定**要不要留住 message**。 而且这不是疏漏，是**当时明写下的取舍**。同文件 `:559-564` 的档注逐字： > ⚠️ Its gate is `declaredHttpStatus(...) >= 500`, NOT `declaresServerFault` … Gating on `declaresServerFault` instead would … （`:564` 后半句给了理由，取它的人应当先读完这一整段再动。） ⇒ **问题因此从「发明一个判别器」缩成一个更小、更可答的问题：** > 既然 `declaresServerFault` 已经在这个函数里被信任到足以决定 `code` 字段的去留，为什么同一个判断不足以决定 message 的去留？`:559-564` 给出的理由，在 #16143 的 `/references` 501 这类**为调用者撰写**的 refusal 面前还成立吗？ 这个改写不构成裁决——它只是把决定箱从开放式设计题收敛成一个对着 `:559-564` 现有论证的是/否。 --- ## ⚠️ 顺带更正卡片 dedup 段里的一行 卡片写：*"**#13242** is about `declaresServerFault` having no consumer."* **#13242 已于 2026-08-29 以 `not_planned` 关闭**，且它的前提在今天的 main 上**已不成立**：它称 PR #13240 移走最后一个生产调用点后「No production call site remains」，而 `error-response.ts:577` 就是一个活的生产调用点。 ⛔ 本席**不重开 #13242**——它自陈「No defect claimed and nothing is broken」，且被 PM 席按 not_planned 关掉是对的处置。记在这里只是为了：**任何人若按 ADR-0049 的 enforce-or-remove 去删 `declaresServerFault`，会同时删掉本卡赖以修复的判别器。** 这条约束必须随卡走。 --- ## 四facet **① 事实（已复核）** `declaredServerFaultAnswer` 的 gate 只看 `declaredHttpStatus >= 500`，因此把「刻意的 REFUSAL」与「服务端 FAULT」一视同仁地把 message 换成 `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE`；同一函数已用 `declaresServerFault({status, code})` 判别 code 字段的去留。#11718 把这段抬成**所有门的唯一中继**，所以擦除是全平台一致的。`/references` 的 501 refusal 因此以 `"Internal server error"` 上线，直到 PR #16143 在**下游一条路由上**局部补掉。 **② 分叉** - **A. 改中继**：让 message 的保留与否也走 `declaresServerFault`（或另一个明确判别器），一次覆盖所有门。 - **B. 维持现状 + 逐路由补丁**：每个 producer-declared 5xx refusal 各自像 #16143 那样在路由内补。 - **C. 第三条**：引入 producer 侧的显式 refusal 声明（例如 status/code 上一个 published allow-list），不复用 `declaresServerFault`。 **③ 各支的代价** - A：半径最大、耐久最强；但改动**每个门、每个 producer-declared 5xx** 的线上字节——是 #15685 当时明确没买的那一半。必须先读懂 `:559-564` 为什么当初没这么做。 - B：每次补丁有界、可测；但缺陷类原样留存，**每一个新的 producer-declared 5xx refusal 都会再次上线成 `"Internal server error"`**，直到有人发现。#16143 已经是第一笔，卡片说的「decaying into a series of route-local patches」正在发生。 - C：最干净的语义，但要新建并维护一份 allow-list，且与已有的 `declaresServerFault` 形成第二套判别，违反 `metadata-read-decorations.ts` 那类「一份清单，不许有第二份私拷贝」的既定纪律（对照本轮的 #16152，正是那条纪律被违反的实例）。 **④ 需要裁决者提供的东西** 一句话：**`:559-564` 记录的「不用 `declaresServerFault` 当 gate」这个取舍，是否只适用于 status 的透传，而不适用于 message 的保留？** 答「是」⇒ 走 A（且 `:559-564` 需补一句划清两者）；答「否」⇒ 走 B 或 C，并应当在 `error-response.ts` 里明写「producer-declared 5xx refusal 的 prose 由路由自己负责保住」，好让下一个作者不必靠踩坑发现。 --- ## 分诊侧的其余判断 - **`domain:cli`**：落点 `packages/rest` 按 lane 表归 `domain:cli`。 - **`bug`**：`/references` 的 501 是 ADR-0110 D3 下**为调用者撰写**的 message（它告诉运维「该去问哪个对象」），被替换成 `"Internal server error"` ⇒ main 上有东西是假的。⛔ 但修复面**拓宽了对外可见的 prose**（今天被吞掉的字符串将开始上线），按机械边界测试落在**需要人工裁决**的一侧——这也是它必须走决定箱而非 `pm:queue` 的第二个理由。 - **p2**：无运行期故障，状态码本身是对的，只是 prose 与日志失真；但影响面是**所有门的所有 producer-declared 5xx refusal**，且已经产生了第一笔逐路由补丁（#16143）。⛔ 不到 p1：调用者拿到的 status 正确，不会误判成功。 - ⛔ **不与 #14656 合并**：那是「轮询路由上该不该记录一个已声明的 501」的决定箱，是**日志**面的子问题；本卡的日志不对称只是第二症状，主症状在**线路字节**上。两卡若同时裁决，A 支会顺带答掉 #14656 的一半——建议裁决者按此顺序看。 --- ⛔ 本席为 triage 席位：不认领、不派单、不写码、不合并、不裁决 decision-box（本会话为 `claude-opus-5`，`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 硬门要求 fable）。 --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## Ruling recorded — option C (director seat, decision batch #58, 2026-09-06)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 (all five batch #58 recommendations adopted).

**Ruling.** Refusal versus fault is a producer-side declaration on the published ADR-0112 envelope, not a status heuristic and not a second allow-list. One optional field (spec card #16335) says "this message is authored for the caller"; `declaredServerFaultAnswer` keeps the message verbatim only when it is present and withholds it otherwise, exactly as today.

**Why not the reframing in triage comment 5556832849.** `declaresServerFault` (`packages/types/src/error-leak.ts`) is `status >= 500 && typeof code === 'string'`. A deliberate refusal such as the `/references` 501 declares both, so gating the message on `declaresServerFault` withholds the same prose the gate withholds now. The `:559-564` note is therefore not the obstacle; the missing declaration is.

**Execution (this card = the relay half, blocked on #16335).**
- Change the single relay `declaredServerFaultAnswer` so every gate inherits it; do not touch routes individually.
- Retire the route-local patch from PR #16143 once the relay handles `/references`; the producer there sets the new field instead.
- Logging follows the same field: a declared refusal is not logged as `[REST] Unhandled error` (this answers half of #14656, which has been told to wait for #16335).
- Constraint carried from triage: `declaresServerFault` keeps its live production caller at `error-response.ts:577`; an ADR-0049 remove pass must not delete it.
- Test: one producer-declared 5xx refusal with the field keeps its message; the same error without the field yields `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE`; an undeclared 5xx still goes through the heuristic.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` (Blocked-by: #16335). Ledger on #12708 (batch #58).

## Unblocked — the single condition this card recorded is met, verified on the merged ref

`pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. Nothing else on the label set moved.

**The condition, quoted from this card's own ruling** (director seat, decision batch #58, 2026-09-06, maintainer 「同意」):

> **Execution (this card = the relay half, blocked on #16335).**

**#16335 is closed `completed`.** ⛔ Not taken from its state alone — 「`closed completed` is not coverage」 — the field itself was measured on `origin/main` at `a36b526f`:

- `packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts` declares the producer-side refusal field on `ApiErrorSchema`, with the rationale in its own docblock (「The producer's user-facing refusal text, verbatim — the producer-side …」, 「**Status-agnostic.** Not a 403 special case: any refusal status may …」).
- `packages/spec/src/api/contract.test.ts:90` pins the shape end-to-end: `ApiErrorSchema.parse({ code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', message: REFERENCES_REFUSAL, httpStatus: 501, refusal: true })`, then 「The declaration rides BESIDE `message`; it never replaces or carries it.」

⇒ the declaration this card was waiting for **exists on the published envelope**. The relay half is now buildable.

Controls on that reading: `userMessage` matches across 13 files in `packages/spec/src` on the same matcher; a fabricated field name returns **0**.

### What the queue inherits, unchanged

The ruling stands as recorded and this seat is ⛔ not re-opening it — refusal versus fault is **a producer-side declaration on the published ADR-0112 envelope**, ⛔ not a status heuristic and ⛔ not a second allow-list. Its four execution constraints ride with the card: change the single relay so every gate inherits it (⛔ do not touch routes individually); retire PR #16143's route-local patch once the relay handles `/references`; a declared refusal is ⛔ not logged as `[REST] Unhandled error`; and `declaresServerFault` **keeps** its live production caller at `error-response.ts:577` — an ADR-0049 remove pass must ⛔ not delete it.

### ⚠️ One thing the next taker must not read past

This card's own sentence — 「the single relay for every producer-declared 5xx at every door」 — **is false on the current tree, and its child says so with measurements.**

**#17153** (sub-issue of this card) measures a **third** withhold arm outside `@objectstack/rest`: `errorResponseBase` in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, gated by `serverFaultProvenance`, which replaces the message of **every** producer-declared 5xx and never consults `declaredServerFaultAnswer`. It is a production door — mounted by `objectstack serve` and by `plugin-dev`, answering `POST {prefix}/analytics/query` among others — and it is pinned by an existing test that asserts the prose IS withheld.

⇒ ⚠️ **「move BOTH arms」 is not the whole job**, and triage on #17153 is explicit that fixing the arm while leaving this card's 「single relay」 sentence in place 「is half the card」. ⭐ Triage also asks for a check for a **fourth** exit before closing — two rounds have each found one more.

⇒ Whether the runtime exit lands in this card's PR or in #17153's is **this card's call**, as #17153 itself says. That is a sequencing decision for whoever claims this, ⛔ not something this unblock decides.

That is the leak surface, and the sentence above routes it to the **manual security/permission floor** rather than out of scope. The dev must raise it explicitly and say what bounds the kept message.

### Prior-ruling search — run BEFORE this claim, and it found a maintainer ruling the card does not cite

⭐ **ADR-0112 `:146`, ruled by the maintainer 2026-08-27**, on this exact family:

> In 5xx sanitisation a **demoted** code … is withheld along with the prose; an **author-declared** `declaredCode` survives. Implemented **once at the shared resolver layer so all doors inherit one rule**; ⛔ no per-registrar variants.

⭐ **`:150` names the one definition and where it is anchored:** 「`serverFaultProvenance` (`packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, **anchored in `scripts/adr-anchors/`**) is the ONE definition … which is what makes "all doors inherit" a **construction** rather than five suites agreeing about literals.」

⇒ ⚠️ **If the one-reader route runs through `serverFaultProvenance`, it touches an ADR-anchored symbol.** That is a real constraint on the route #17153 suggests, and ⛔ it is not a reason to re-derive per door — the same ruling forbids exactly that.

⭐ **`:152` is the line that matters most, because it scopes the ruling away from this card's axis:**

> **Scope, exactly.** This rules the CODE channel only. The PROSE axis of the same ruling — the dispatcher door adopting the structural withhold for every declared 5xx message — is #12281, a separate card … it is the `'declared'` limb of the same `serverFaultProvenance` function and **deliberately not applied here**.

⇒ the prose withhold this card now proposes to **partially reverse** for declared refusals was itself a deliberate, separately-carded decision. ⚠️ The batch #58 ruling on this card and ADR-0112's scope note are **probably** compatible — `refusal` did not exist when the prose axis was decided — but that compatibility must be **argued from both texts**, ⛔ not assumed because the newer ruling is newer.

⚠️ **NOT MEASURED:** `GET /issues/12281` returns **404** in this repository, while `[#12281]` pins are live in `packages/runtime/src` (including one that records 「⚠️ **REVERSED, deliberately.** Until #12281 this case asserted the opposite」). ⇒ that card lives somewhere I cannot read from this session; ⛔ I am recording its absence as unmeasured, not as nonexistent.
